*_Our SVN is hosted on googlecode. To check out the code please go to:_*

             http://code.google.com/p/unicase/source/checkout

As a regular developer you will only need to check out all plugins in trunk/core and trunk/developer.

Repository layout:

    * Root Level:
          o /trunk: the current state of development.
          o /tags: used to create tags to special revisions, like releases.
          o /branches: used to branch of from trunk to develop new features in isolation from trunk.
    * Below root level (in trunk, tags and branches):
          o /core: contains all core plugins that are part of the release.
          o /developer: contains resources for developers, such as scripts, configurations
          o /deployment: contains plugins, features and the update site for release and deployment.
          o /test: contains plugins for testing.
          o /other: contains other plugins and features that are not released with the unicase client feature.



===Repository rules:===

    * *Always update before commit.*
    * *Only commit code without compilation problems.*
    * *If you add a new new plugin to the trunk, announce this to the mailinglist.*
